documentedDependencies.reason: Native-tested autonomous FlyTo RCS/pause, explicit TorchOff and direct RCS commands release unowned shallow AI torch input. Active NavData excludes direct-actuator cleanup. Changed escape/retreat destinations stop obsolete controls. Momentum, fuel, new RCS input, active courses and physical/player control paths are preserved. No affordability gate or new rescue policy. Numerical flight remains external; see Navigation/FLIGHT-CONTROL-HANDOFF.md.
Tests/OrbitalCheck/EconomyChecks executes event ordering, loading, partial trips and delivery; this role model does not calculate physics or production recipes.
TargetLifecycle models permanent removal and reconstruction. Traffic adds the missing Ship-to-stellar conversion interleaving.
StationReturn is an optional saved directive using native FlyTo/Dock; ordinary cargo Main and market loading do not imply it.
People may transfer during a nonstation visit; character-level pledges, permissions and agendas remain native. No prisoner-transfer policy is inferred.

ApplySaveData removes only the unique original INTERREGIONAL cargo plus local Scav/Police fallback pattern with matching native cargo ownership/origin. Native restore and unchanged captured payloads are tested; ambiguous histories/missing hulls and historical orphan refunds are excluded.

Native-tested local patrol/ambush/guard/encounter coordinate binding and police SFF placement preserve actual planetary gravity wells/parent references; otherwise use the regional station frame. Departure validation shared. No global gravity/nearest query, free-target prediction, combat or interplanetary course changes. Full military behavior and flight geometry remain unexpanded; see Navigation/LOCAL-NAVIGATION-FRAMES.md.

Multi-actor quantities, concrete item acceptance, hull pool sizing, price/cache identity, refund staging and Main/Flee/priority/save-load eligibility are native-tested outside the finite graph. The delivery label denotes handled cargo including deliberately discarded overflow; it does not assert all units fit. No new route or economic destination is invented.

Assembly-derived role/command references close the selector inventory gap, not the behavioral-model gap. Guards, branch ordering, physical outcomes and cross-actor transitions for these entries remain unexpanded; separate native patch tests must provide compatibility evidence.
